description: Hand-curated golden snippets used by 03-index.ts to validate parse quality. Each entry is checked against the parsed text via case-insensitive substring match. If the parsed clause doesn't contain the golden snippet, the build fails — catches mammoth regressions or unintended cross-release drift. IDs MUST point at actual leaf clauses (no descendants); snippets are kept short (a single distinctive phrase) so they survive minor whitespace/formatting differences. Updated after the v1 pipeline run when several initial IDs turned out to be section-headers with deeper children.
